strengths: The proposed approach is highly intuitive. (but, too obvious.)
This paper uses knowledge distillation as a solution to address model collapse.
This paper conducts experiments on image generation using VAE and DDPM, as well as text summarization using the T5 model.
Applying KD to mitigate model collapse might be a possible solution.
The proposed method is easy to follow.
The structure of the paper is clear.
weaknesses: They merely used the conventional knowledge distillation (KD) method. I think they should have compared various KD methods to identify a more suitable approach for resolving model collapse on the same task.
Their experimentation is limited to adjusting the hyperparameters of the model.

For iterative cases (repeated cycles of data generation and model retraining, as you mentioned in Introduction), I think it is necessary to assess how severe the model collapse becomes and to what extent it can be resolved.
The template of the article is not officially provided.

The models used in this paper are VAE and DDPM. Can more advanced models be used for image generation, and can the resolution of the generated images be improved? This can better prove the generalization of the proposed method.
Lack of comparison with existing approaches to mitigate model collapse.

The paper’s format does not follow the ICLR requirements. Additionally, the presentation is poor, lacking clear motivation and an introduction to the methodology. Many unnecessary figures that should have been placed in the appendix occupy a large portion of the main text, making the paper resemble an experimental report. Even so, it fails to reach ten pages. This submission appears extremely unprofessional.

There is no formal definition about "Model Collapse" indicated in the paper, the author should describe it for both text model and image model in more details. Also I do not agree that the test set loss and ROUGE scores are a good metric for model collapse indication.
The adopted datasets for image generation are quite simple. The authors should use more complex datasets.
There is no theoretical/empirical analysis about the results and findings, the authors should think about adding these.
The proposed method is still worse than $M_0$ after training with longer steps for language models. The authors should analyze this more.
The authors have modified the template style, which could be problematic.
